meta.description: Unofficial taxonomy of Hugging Face audio-to-audio models (pipeline_tag=audio-to-audio). Subcategories are defined by use case, not by HF's task label.
meta.signal_count_note: signal_count = snapshot models with at least one listed tag (case-insensitive). An estimate: tags are self-reported, and the signals overlap.

subcategories.name: Speech restoration (universal cleanup)
subcategories.definition: Degraded speech in, clean speech out, recovering lost signal instead of only subtracting noise. The user's framing: a predictive approach that improves the audio, where older reductive denoisers lose speaker fidelity.
use_cases: Making TTS training data from imperfect speech recordings (the user's own use in experimental TTS work)
General cleanup: noisy background recordings, poor microphones
signals: tags: universal speech enhancement, universal-speech-enhancement, speech-restoration, audio-restoration, restoration

examples.note: Canonical example. Mamba-SSM based universal speech enhancement, language-agnostic, multiple input sample rates. 56,656 all-time downloads.

subcategories.notes: Overlaps speech-enhancement: RE-USE also carries the speech-enhancement tag. The line between the two is restoration (predictive/generative) vs suppression (subtractive); metadata alone doesn't separate them.

subcategories.name: Speaker isolation (target speaker extraction)
subcategories.definition: Mixed audio in, only the target speaker out, removing other voices as well as noise. Narrower than general cleanup; replaces earlier cruder heuristic approaches.
use_cases: Ancillary gate for ASR alongside VAD: isolate the intended dictation audio from background speech and noise
signals: tags: target-speaker-extraction, speaker-extraction, voice-isolation, personalized-speech-enhancement, background-voice-removal

examples.note: Canonical example. ONNX, streaming; tagged for voice agents, telephony, call centres. 2,615 all-time downloads.

subcategories.notes: Also tagged speech-enhancement, so it shows up in that signal too. Read 'VAC' in the dictated brief as VAD (voice activity detection).

subcategories.name: Speech enhancement and denoising
subcategories.definition: General-purpose speech improvement: noise suppression, denoising, dereverberation.
use_cases: General audio improvement for speech (podcasts, calls, on-device)
signals: tags: speech-enhancement, speech-denoising, noise-suppression, denoising, noise-reduction, dereverberation

examples.note: Canonical example of a model built for general-purpose audio improvement. TFLite/ONNX/Core ML, on-device iOS and Android. 4,180 all-time downloads.

subcategories.notes: Broadest tag signal; its 183 includes members of speech-restoration and target-speaker-extraction, which also use the speech-enhancement tag.

subcategories.name: Stem separation
subcategories.definition: A music mix in, separate stems out (vocals, drums, bass, other).
signals: tags: music-source-separation, stem-separation, source-separation, music-separation, demucs, htdemucs

examples.note: Demucs is the canonical stem separator. This repo has 0 all-time downloads in the snapshot.

subcategories.notes: No Meta/facebook Demucs repo is in the audio-to-audio snapshot. The most-downloaded Demucs repos are conversions: MansfieldPlumbing/Demucs_v4_TRT (3,361), cstr/htdemucs-GGUF (2,487), dexxdean/htdemucs-coreml (1,352). The tag signal also catches non-music source separation.

subcategories.name: Instruction-guided audio editing
subcategories.definition: Audio plus a natural-language instruction in, edited audio out. The user flags this as a very unusual entry in the category.

examples.note: Canonical example. PyTorch, flow matching. 121 all-time downloads.

subcategories.notes: Other candidates from the looser signal: heng1024/AnchorSteer-weights, mimbres/spansynth-edit, mlx-community/Step-Audio-EditX-8bit / -bf16, nijta/acoustic-token-admixture, OpenRB-Lab/AURA. Not yet checked.

subcategories.name: Voice conversion
subcategories.definition: Speech or singing in one voice in, the same content in another voice out.
signals: tags: rvc, vc, voice conversion, voice-conversion, voice2voice, svc, singing-voice-conversion, so-vits-svc, seed-vc

examples.note: Canonical example. RVC/VITS based; ships ONNX. 1,895 all-time downloads.

subcategories.notes: Largest subcategory by tag signal. Includes singing voice conversion (svc tags), which could become a child subcategory.
